# CAS-ViT-T FPN (ResNet-50)

Semantic Segmentation · `casvit-t-fpn-resnet50_512x512` · DX-APP Python example

Semantic Segmentation model, evaluated on ADE20K.

**Input** 512 × 512 × 3 · **Dataset** ADE20K · **License** MIT · **Quantization** Q-Lite, Q-Pro

![CAS-ViT-T FPN (ResNet-50) output](result.webp)

Full card with copy buttons and dark/light theme (open it in a browser; GitHub shows its source): [model.html](model.html)

## Quick start

Run from the dx_app root after `./install.sh` and `./build.sh`.

```bash
# from the dx_app root
./setup_sample_models.sh --models casvit_t_seg_fpn_resnet50-1
```

**Python**

```bash
python src/python_example/semantic_segmentation/casvit_seg/casvit-t-fpn-resnet50_512x512/casvit-t-fpn-resnet50_512x512_sync.py \
  --model assets/models/casvit-t-fpn-resnet50_512x512.dxnn \
  --image sample/img/sample_parking.jpg
```

**C++**

```bash
./build.sh --target casvit-t-fpn-resnet50_512x512_sync   # once
./bin/casvit-t-fpn-resnet50_512x512_sync \
  -m assets/models/casvit-t-fpn-resnet50_512x512.dxnn \
  -i sample/img/sample_parking.jpg
```

## Accuracy

| Quantization | mIoU |
|---|---:|
| Raw · ONNX | 43.89 |
| Q-Lite | 43.69 (−0.20) |
| Q-Pro | 0.40 (−43.49) |

ADE20K · difference vs Raw in brackets.

> **Note:** Q-Pro is 43.49 points below Raw on mIoU.
